subject.title: improve(gateway): bound visible history page reads

question: Should the existing history endpoint retain numeric `nextCursor` responses during the compatibility window, or should opaque generation-aware cursors be introduced through an explicit versioned or opt-in contract?
rationale: The implementation improves bounded paging but changes a shipped HTTP response representation; deciding whether that compatibility break is acceptable is an API-policy choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Use an additive cursor transition
options.body: Keep numeric responses on the existing contract and expose opaque cursors only behind an explicit version or opt-in, with coverage for both paths.

options.title: Approve the response-format break
options.body: Accept opaque cursors as the new default only after gateway owners explicitly document the upgrade impact and deprecation policy.

recommendation.title: Use an additive cursor transition
recommendation.body: Keep numeric responses on the existing contract and expose opaque cursors only behind an explicit version or opt-in, with coverage for both paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged cursor foundation and the follow-up implementation, making them the best initial routing point for the intended compatibility policy.
